title: Foil-Wrapped Ribs On The Grill
ingredients: ¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat the Grill: Prepare your grill for direct cooking over medium heat (350° to 450°F)
Mix the Rub: In a small bowl, combine the salt, paprika, granulated garlic, thyme, and black pepper.
Season the Ribs: Season the spare rib rack evenly on both sides with the rub, tapping it gently into the meat.

Wrap in Foil: Because spare ribs are long and heavy, cut the rack crosswise in half if necessary to fit your foil sheets, then double-wrap them tightly in heavy-duty aluminum foil to lock in the juices.

Foil Cook (1 Hour to 1 Hour 15 Minutes): Place the foil packet(s) on the grill over direct medium heat, close the lid, and cook for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes, turning the packets over once or twice halfway through. (Spare ribs require that extra 15 minutes compared to baby backs to start breaking down the denser connective tissue).
Rest & Unwrap: Remove the packet from the grill and let it rest for 10 minutes. Carefully open the foil (watch out for escaping steam) and discard the foil and rendered fat.

Place the unwrapped spare ribs directly on the grill grates, bone-side down. Grill over direct medium heat with the lid closed, basting and turning once or twice with the ½ cup of barbecue sauce, until the sauce is sizzling and caramelized
Serve: Let the ribs rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
